_comment: Last upstream release verified against xtctx's scrapers. The weekly upstream-watch workflow compares npm against this file and opens or updates a single rolling draft PR bumping moved versions when a tracked tool publishes a new release: a free signal for when a format *could* have changed, without spending API credit invoking the tools. Verify formats locally with `npm run capture:formats` (or dispatch drift-canary) before marking the PR ready to merge.

_untracked.cursor: not distributed on npm — format changes ship with the Cursor app
_untracked.copilot (VS Code): not on npm — ships inside the VS Code extension
_untracked.antigravity: not on npm — ships with the Antigravity app
